ValidationRule.description: Used to restrict case closure to L2 team for certain cases only
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Deceased_Customer', OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Issue', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Complaint', ISPICKVAL (Sub_Type__c , 'Account Block/Unblock'), ISPICKVAL (Sub_Type__c , 'Request Adhoc Statement/Letter'), ISPICKVAL (Sub_Type__c , 'Account Closure'), ISPICKVAL (Sub_Type__c , 'Dormant Account Reactivation') ), $UserRole.Name <> 'L2', TEXT(Region_Flag__c) <> 'Jordan', $User.L2_Access__c != TRUE, ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only L2 agents can close this case!
